scope: beta passport DSC issuance through active managed issuer profiles; existing CSCA CSR and governed certificate enrollment remain the CSCA ceremony

public_route.operator_claim_source: gateway-validated authenticated principal and organization context

authority.organization_context: authenticated organization; request cannot select another tenant
authority.operator_grant: trusted gateway operator identity and certificate-issue permission are required and fail closed; ordinary signing-key:create or issuer payload-signing grants are insufficient
authority.signing_identity: resolve active organization, issuer DID, purpose, format, and algorithm to exactly one issuer profile
authority.key_reference: derived from the resolved profile; never accepted from the caller

supported.algorithm: ES256 for this beta issuance action; existing CSR and offline authority algorithm support is unchanged
supported.private_key_custody: KMS only; no generated, imported, exported, or serialized private key

certificate.serial: positive unpredictable DER integer of no more than 20 octets, unique per issuing CSCA
certificate.subject: bounded validated C, O, and CN from a verified managed DSC CSR; C agrees with the active CSCA and passport issuing country
certificate.csca: pre-enrolled active and non-revoked CA with valid self-signature, critical CA basic constraints, and keyCertSign usage; CSCA issuance is outside this action
certificate.dsc: signed by an active valid CSCA, critical non-CA basic constraints and digitalSignature usage
certificate.validity: bounded by policy; DSC validity must fit within issuer CSCA validity
certificate.csr: verify proof of possession and require its SPKI to equal the current DSC subject profile KMS public key
certificate.role_separation: DSC subject and CSCA signer use different active profiles, purposes, and KMS key references
certificate.signature: require active CSCA certificate public key to equal current CSCA signer profile KMS public key; sign DER TBS via that profile and verify the returned signature against that current KMS public key before publication
certificate.chain: verify issuer and subject, signature, validity, CA and leaf usage, and active non-revoked CSCA before attachment

concurrency.rotation: recheck both active profile revisions and current KMS public keys after signing; use a revision fence at the lifecycle and attachment commit, rejecting any intervening change
concurrency.retry: scope an idempotency key to tenant, DSC profile, CSCA profile, and request digest; replay of identical input returns the stored result, changed input conflicts, and issuer serial reservation is atomic
concurrency.failure: a failed check publishes no certificate and does not mutate lifecycle or profile attachment

rejections: missing, ambiguous, inactive, stale, or wrong-purpose profile
caller-supplied signing service configuration or key locator
forged or mismatched CSR, issuer, certificate, signature, country, or critical extension
provider public key different from the profile's published key
profile or provider key rotation during issuance
public_projection: certificate PEM, chain PEM, issuer identity, subject, serial, validity, and lifecycle status only; no private material, provider token, service configuration, or key locator

cases.name: valid_dsc
cases.result: issue, verify, attach, and return one DSC certificate under an enrolled KMS-backed CSCA

cases.name: same_request_retry
cases.result: return the original certificate without new signing or mutation

cases.name: public_projection
cases.result: omit private key, KMS token, service configuration, and key locator
